control.classHint: Class labels appear after selecting a model.
control.enableTracking: Enable ByteTrack (box tasks only; automatic for video)
control.trackingHint: Enables trackId on bboxes, trails & counting lines/zones.
control.drawLineHint: Draw lines/zones via right-click menu or the buttons next to ROI tool.

image.dragHint: Drag image here, or click "Select Image".

video.analysisHint: Samples are processed sequentially at the selected FPS; speed depends on inference performance. Each run resets counts and starts at the beginning. Low sampling rates can still miss events. Changing the model, parameters or rules stops the run. Video events do not send live alerts.
video.lineHint: Click two points to create a line, then finish drawing.
video.zoneHint: Click polygon vertices, then click the first point to close (at least three vertices).
video.decodeError: Cannot decode this video. Use a browser-supported video format.

wall.emptyHint: Enter RTSP address and click Start

monitor.countersHint: Enable Tracking and draw counting lines/zones on the canvas to see stats here.
monitor.alertRule: Rule: Alert triggers when target class appears for ≥ N consecutive frames.
monitor.noLogs: No logs yet (appears after model selection / inference).

webhook.hint: Backend sends JSON in selected format. Cooldown deduplicates by (kind, ref) to prevent spam.

config.dragHint: Drag JSON here. Includes: model params / engine / OSD / ROI / counting lines-zones / alerts / Webhook

tasks.nmsHint: Auto preserves upstream defaults. NMS-free requires an end-to-end detection head; IoU is not used in this mode.
tasks.fusionHint: Select a task=depth checkpoint. Detection, segmentation, pose and OBB run depth on the same frame, using extra time and memory. Segmentation uses mask medians; other tasks use a box-center estimate.
tasks.sampleHint: Sampled map {{width}} × {{height}}, original numeric scale preserved
tasks.metricHint: Values are model estimates in meters. Validate or calibrate the scale for your camera.
tasks.hoverHint: Move the pointer to inspect an approximate original-image location
tasks.classLimit: Showing the first 80 matches. Search to narrow the list.
